newsitem.title: USA: Cigna extends offer for Healthsource.
newsitem.headline: Cigna extends offer for Healthsource.

text.p: Cigna Corp said Monday its CHC Acquisition Corp unit was extending its offer to purchase all outstanding shares of common stock of Healthsource Inc for $21.75 per share throuygh June 20 because certain required state regulatory approvals have not yet been obtained..
The offer had been scheduled to expire May 30.

According to IBJ Schroder Bank & Trust Co, the depositary for the offer, as of the close of business on May 30, 62.2 million shares of Healthsource common stock had been validly tendered and not withdrawn pursuant to the offer, including 4.3 million shares tendered pursuant to notices of guaranteed delivery.
